scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n fe,be -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n fe,be -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host" "HOST=0.0.0.0 ALLOW_LAN=1 npm run dev --prefix backend"
